description: Pick one or more random whole numbers in a range with Perkadoo's Random Number Generator, like 1 to 100. Several numbers never repeat. Uses public drand randomness, so anyone can check it. Returns the numbers and a public results link to share.

count.description: How many different numbers to pick. Default 1.

max.description: The highest number that can come up.

min.description: The lowest number that can come up. Default 1.

title.description: A name shown on the results page.

name: pick_random_numbers
title: Pick random numbers
